gerekce: Current fundamentals are favorable: revenue, operating profit, net profit, operating cash flow, and free cash flow all grew year over year, while liquidity is positive. However, the standalone valuation is unsupported by the evidence provided. A 47.76x P/E, 2.09% parent-attributed FCF yield, and 36.42x lease-exclusive EV to operating income leave little margin for error. The subject's 2.09% earnings yield is also well below the 4.61% external-peer median. Because the report explicitly contains no forward estimates, it offers no evidence that growth can persist at a level sufficient to justify this premium.
